build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon of allowed pieces
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models for consuming consecutive word pieces
compose_and_project_decomposition: compose an input graph with a lexicon graph and project output to get word decompositions
compute_alignment_graph: compute the alignment graph by composing token graph with decomposition graph and projecting input
compute_sequence_loss: compute sequence level loss by subtracting forward scores of intersected emissions and alignment graphs
